title: BENCHMARKING OF QUANTUM AND CLASSICAL SDP RELAXATIONS FOR QUBO FORMULATIONS OF REAL-WORLD LOGISTICS PROBLEMS
reasoning: The paper is a technical performance benchmarking of optimization algorithms (specifically Sums of Squares Semidefinite Programming relaxations and Hamiltonian Updates) applied to logistics problems like the vehicle routing problem and the slotting problem. It contains no components evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
